nodes.original_target: Measurement as finite descent is derived structure (C15), but the projection postulate (E^2=E with spectral structure) and the observer pairing and normalization behind probability-like outputs are imported; O024 audits seven pairings and does not select a unique Born rule.

Under the supplied lift c = sqrt(w) e^{i theta}, |c|^2 = w is redundant, phase lies in the kernel of the phase-blind map delta, and phase reappears as a mixing cross term: (1,1) and (1,-1) share a quotient point and differ in the fiber. Superposition is observer-relative; no probability mass in the fiber.

Inside the declared finite model, UsefulQC iff S (race, floor, reachability, H1 advantage); each S_i independently necessary; S satisfiable. A criterion, not a proof that any device satisfies S; race uses an imported rate.

No function of L1 weights computes the interfered weight |sum c_s|^2: L1-equivalent configurations (1,1) and (1,-1) differ by cross terms +2 / -2. Statement is relative to the supplied complex amplitude carrier.

Continuity of reversible dynamics and global field uniqueness across n (needs local tomography) are imported; the complex amplitude lift requires an explicit U(1) phase fiber and complex involution. The discrete shadow does not separate U(1) from Q/Z torsion (QM-062-C4).

A nontrivial invariant phase forces a conjugation (L1); within the declared Frobenius comparison class R/C/H, R-signed and H are excluded (L2); J^2=-I with S^2=+I gives the complex product on {aI+bJ} and Z[i] embeds (L3). The conditional forcing of C needs continuity of reversible dynamics and field uniqueness (QM-062-C8..C10). OB-U1 sharpened, not discharged.

For two paths, coherent intensity equals the L1 sum plus the real part of relative loop holonomy; holonomy and intensity are invariant under vertex gauge repair; U(1) connections on a tree are gauge-trivial; intensity does not factor through L1 weights when holonomy varies. Higher-form holonomy refused; matrix-valued SU(2) trace bound is a CONJECTURE.

The 064, 074 and 083 annex claims (phase 1-cochain coboundary d1 d0 = 0, gauge invariance of triangle cycle holonomy, no-signaling marginal condition, and L1 contraction of stochastic Markov kernels) are mechanized in DerivationDagQMClosure.lean and NoSignalling.lean.

For a finite nonnegative joint table w on A x B with W>0, the product defect Phi(w) vanishes iff w factors through its marginals. Phi is basis-relative and does not see entanglement (Bell state and the classical mixture share the (1/2,0,0,1/2) table).

Relative to a declared finite family of product points, a separating functional (phi(P_k)>=t, phi(w)<t) shows w is not in the convex hull. Soundness only; every entangled state having a witness is not claimed; general separability is not addressed.

The bit shadow is derived (P7-C1..C4) but the qubit and superposition are obstructed: the Q1-Q4 import price list names what must be added; completeness of that list is only an interpretive reading (P7-C7, fenced). The generalized Bloch-contraction statement (P7-C10) is a CONJECTURE and the ledger records a computation refuting a sharpened form.
Bell theorem is obstructed clause by clause with three named admissions; no derivation of quantum violation or of the Tsirelson bound from the finite tables.

Bare joint tables are always separable (P8-C3); under a single global joint table the finite CHSH bound is 2; the PR box reaches 4 and has no joint table. The load-bearing hypothesis is the existence of one global joint table. Tsirelson ceiling is not derived (P8-C8 OPEN).

In a bipartite joint distribution rho(a,b|x,y), the no-signaling marginal condition holds under an admitted composition rule, and local marginals do not force product factorization. The statement is about admitted tables, not about relativistic causality (that is Q-held).

The half trace norm is the distinguishability metric under four imports: quantum interface M_n(C), trace-distance axioms (unitary invariance, classical total-variation reduction, homogeneity), CPTP compatibility and edge additivity. Does not survive removal of those imports.

Quotient invariance of the trace-distance defect (Thm 4), finite convex duality (Thm 5) and existence of bounded dual witnesses (Thm 6) hold over any finite-dimensional normed space; identifying the dual with the trace-zero ball and the matrix lift need the spectral theorem (imported).

CPTP-monotonicity of a functional j does not pin j = half trace norm: j and 2j are both monotone. Many monotone measures exist (relative entropy, fidelity-based); breadth upgrade (norm not proportional to trace norm) not constructed.
A column-stochastic kernel does not increase the L1 norm: |Sx|_1 <= |x|_1 (finite classical shadow of trace-norm contraction).

A stochastic kernel preserves states and composes; a CPTP map with Kraus operators induces a column-stochastic population shadow after a basis choice and diagonal read. The induced kernel is basis-relative and the diagonal shadow does not fix the full channel.
